title: Stationery overview · Standard items & recommended print stocks
slide_intent: Consider stationery as a family of working formats. A reader should recognize the sender whether holding a card, opening an envelope or viewing a presentation.
strategic_value: Repeating the same mark and curve across routine correspondence can build familiarity through frequent everyday contact.
demonstration: A numbered inventory connects five formats to an overlapping arrangement of actual-size relationships. A separate list specifies bright white uncoated paper and card stock options.
practical_value: Select the appropriate production template and paper stock for the item. Match each number in the list to its specimen.

content_islands.name: Inventory and stocks
content_islands.spec: List letterhead, business card, A5 note, envelope and presentation at left. Set the stock recommendations and weights below.

content_islands.name: Stationery family
content_islands.spec: Overlap the five specimens in a neutral field at right. Number them to match the list, keeping both red display surfaces and white writing surfaces visible.
